info.title: MateMágico Champions API
info.description: Identity is derived only from the Session (Authorization: Bearer). No route accepts an actor identifier. Errors: AUTH-001..005, MEM-001..005, SC-001..005 (plus USR/SCH codes).

post.summary: Create a School; the creator becomes SCHOOL_ADMIN

get.summary: Read a School (requires school:read in it)
List topics (ACTIVE only; with schoolId and question:create, any status is allowed)

post.summary: Create a topic (requires question:create in schoolId)

patch.summary: Update or deactivate a topic (requires question:update in schoolId)

get.summary: List questions with filters (readers see PUBLISHED without the answer key; authors pass schoolId)

post.summary: Create a DRAFT question (requires question:create in schoolId)

get.summary: Read a question (published version for readers; any version for authors)

post.summary: Publish the current DRAFT (requires question:publish in schoolId)
Archive the published (or draft) version (requires question:update)
Create version N+1 as a DRAFT; published versions are never mutated

get.summary: List available published exams; requires school:read and schoolId

post.summary: Create a draft exam with deterministic question selection (exam:create)

get.summary: Get an exam in the authenticated school context

post.summary: Start an available published exam (school:read); does not create an Attempt
